title: Controlplane cafe — standup scratchpad and action log
summary: Informal standup notes capturing blockers, recent incidents, quick decisions on routing/auth tweaks, and action items for quota experiments.
content:
Agenda (coffee + whiteboard format)
- Quick sync: control plane health, routing flakiness, auth token refresh issues, quota anomalies.
- Rapid triage of 11/11 incident (short burst of 502s to hosted API due to allocator thrash).
- Decide canary window + feature flag churn cadence.

Notes / stream of consciousness (scratchpad)
- Marco: saw allocator churn between 03:14-03:20 UTC — scaling goroutines oscillated, led to transient 502s for user-facing hosted-api. Heap/FDs looked ok. Possibly scheduling race in node-rebalancer. (PLT-4823)
- Aisha: routing auth edge — refresh token path (/v1/internal/token/refresh) had a 12% increase in latency after codepath change; dig logs show blocked calls waiting on retry backoff. Suspect exponential-backoff misconfiguration after last deploy.
- Jon: quotas dashboard flashed warnings — per-tenant burst counters exceeded soft-threshold for 2 customers. Not strictly throttled but alerts noisy. Need to tune alert runbooks.
- Marta: noticed several small PRs merged that change header propagation in the ingress -> controlplane path, might affect routing decisions for region routing (eu-west-1 fallback). Reverting one PR removed a spike in error rates in eu-west test cluster.

Metrics snapshot (informal)
- 99th p95/p99 token latency (control plane proxy): p95=120ms, p99=420ms during spike window.
- Allocator scale events: 26 events in 6 minutes (spike), typical is 2-3.
- Auth refresh endpoint error rate: baseline 0.05% -> peak 1.8% (11:00 UTC)
- Quota soft-threshold alerts: 4 tenants triggered, 2 sustained > 10m.

Root cause hypotheses (brainstorm)
- Allocator thrash: autoscaler cooldown too low + aggressive scaling policy for ephemeral pools. Might need smoothing or minimum steady-state pool size.
- Auth latency bump: change in retry backoff (PR #487) accidentally increased retry jitter leading to request pileups.
- Routing errors in eu-west: header propagation change caused region-tag to be lost for a subset of requests; fallback to global route increased load to other pools.

Decisions made during sync
- Immediate revert of the jitter/backoff change on auth service (Aisha to open hotfix PR and coordinate rollback).
- Add a short-term limiter on allocator scale frequency: enforce min 30s between scale-down events for ephemeral pools (Marco to prototype config flag).
- Quota alerts: change soft-threshold alert to "warn-only" for next 48h while we tune thresholds and add tenant-level burst metrics to dashboard (Jon to update alert rules).
- Canary window: expand canary window from 15m to 45m for controlplane routing-affecting PRs; enable feature flag gating for header-propagation changes.

Action items (owner — ETA — ticket/PR)
- Aisha: open hotfix PR to revert exponential-backoff change, monitor auth-refresh latency; ETA: 2026-11-12 16:00 UTC; linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-service/pull/498
- Marco: prototype allocator cooldown flag and run in staging for 24h; ETA: 2026-11-13; ticket: PLT-4879
- Jon: adjust quota alert thresholds and add tenant-burst graph to console; ETA: 2026-11-14; runbook update doc link (draft): https://confluence.internal/redwood/quotas-runbook
- Marta: add extra logging around header propagation and deploy behind feature flag; ETA: 2026-11-13; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/514
- Nina (me): schedule follow-up retro on 2026-11-16 to review results of hotfix & allocator fwq; send calendar invite.

Open questions / things to follow up
- Do we need a separate backoff policy for internal refresh calls vs external auth endpoints? (risk: internal ops overload)
- Long-term: rethink allocator policy for ephemeral vs reserved pools — can we add predictive scaling using recent load windows? (owner: platform-ops research)
- Quotas: should we introduce tenant-specific burst buckets or rewrite the per-tenant quota checks to be token-aware? (workshop item)

Quick wins (low effort)
- Flip header-propagation feature flag to off for eu-west until logging added. (Marta)
- Shorten alert notification to paging only for sustained hits >15m. (Jon)

Meeting artifacts & refs
- Incident timeline (raw): slack:#platform-controlplane thread ts:1678923456
- Related tickets: PLT-4823 (allocator thrash), PLT-4879 (cooldown flag), AUTH-129 (auth backoff), ROUTE-237 (eu-west header fallback)
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/512, /pull/514, auth-service/pull/498

Notas personales / scratch ends
- Keep this doc intentionally rough — will convert to polished post-mortem if incident escalates.
- Reminder: bring sample logs for stateful allocator to retro so we can plot event inter-arrival times.

Next sync: daily standup + focused alloc triage tomorrow 09:30 PT (2026-11-13).
